evidence.quoted_text: issue="$(gh issue list --state open --search 'ratchet in:title' --json number,title --jq '[.[] | select(.title == "ratchet")][0].number // empty')"
evidence.reason: The workflow's issue lookup uses `gh issue list` without `--limit` or pagination. `gh issue list` defaults to 30 results, so the exact-title `ratchet` issue can be missed if more than 30 open issues match the search, causing the job to create a duplicate. This is an implementation defect in the existing intended open-or-update behavior.
